name: NetForum xWeb API
description: Connect Drupal to the NetForum xWeb API for association-management integrations.
project_description:
The NetForum xWeb API module provides a developer-friendly SDK for interacting with NetForum’s xWeb SOAP web service, enabling seamless integration between Drupal and NetForum. Designed to accelerate development, the module abstracts the complexity of SOAP communication and xWeb authentication, offering clean, object-oriented PHP interfaces for executing queries and consuming data from NetForum.

 This module leverages the excellent WsdlToPhp/PackageGenerator library to generate strongly-typed PHP proxy classes from NetForum’s WSDL definitions. It includes a standard set of generated proxy classes based on the latest public available WSDL, providing out-of-the-box support for common xWeb operations. However, because each association may customize their NetForum implementation, the module also supports generating custom proxy classes using the association's specific WSDL.

 NetForum is an association management software solution. It is a feature-rich, cloud-based AMS that optimizes every stage of the membership lifecycle.
